title: Punjab Assembly 2027

INC.note: alone; no INDIA-bloc tie-up with AAP in Punjab

SAD.note: alone; no SAD-BSP alliance stated for 2027

poll_corrections.rule: no PB pollster-error ledger built yet (2022 final-window vote-share polls not yet curated); corrections 0, unrated sigma applies

new_entrant_flag.entrant: Akali Dal (Waris Punjab De) - Amritpal Singh
new_entrant_flag.evidence: polling 8.5-14% (SCORE 8.5, People's Pulse 14) with zero presence in PB2022 baseline and GE2024; satisfies the N=46 rule 'serious contender invisible to both baseline AE and prior GE'. TN2026/TVK precedent: all CALLs suppressed to WATCH-FLAG.

resolution.source: Election Commission of India official results (results.eci.gov.in), party-wise seat tally at first full declaration of all 117 seats
rules: Bloc seat totals = sum of seats won by the member parties listed in `blocs` as composed at freeze; post-result defections, mergers and letters of support are ignored
If an alliance splits BEFORE polling, a re-run forecast (new ledger rows) supersedes; these rows still resolve against freeze-time bloc composition
'wins majority' = bloc seats >= 59 of 117 at first full declaration; countermanded/postponed seats count as not won unless they decide the question, in which case resolution waits for them
'is largest' = strictly more seats than every other modeled bloc (independents and unmodeled parties are not blocs); an exact tie resolves NO for all blocs
Seat-threshold questions resolve on the same official tally
If the election is not held by 2027-12-31, rows resolve VOID: logged and excluded from scoring, never silently dropped

quality_flags: NEW-ENTRANT FLAG ACTIVE: Waris Punjab De (Amritpal Singh) polls 8.5-14% with no electoral baseline - the exact TVK/TN2026 pattern. All would-be CALLs are suppressed to WATCH-FLAG per the validated N=46 rule.
All final-window polls are unrated agencies; two partisan-affiliated polls (Desh Ka Verdict/INC, Aapka Opinion/AAP) excluded - seat-only projections, no vote shares.
Poll spread is extreme: AAP 27-38, SAD 6-19 across agencies in the same window.
WPD is not a simulatable bloc (zero baseline): its 8-14% will come asymmetrically from AAP's and SAD's Panthic vote, which the uniform-swing Monte Carlo cannot represent.

tripwires.watch: WPD trajectory in later polls (toward 20%+ = TN2026 fracture pattern; fade below 5% = flag review)
tripwires.effect: fracture would invalidate all two-way simulations; fade would lift the flag and make the gate decidable

tripwires.watch: Any SAD-BSP or SAD-WPD alliance formation
tripwires.effect: re-bloc and re-run with tau transfers

tripwires.watch: A rated agency (CVoter/CSDS/Axis) publishes a vote-share poll

tripwires.effect: insider-flow signal; sustained one-way flow triggers re-run
